text: Piotr, a Polish Briton, comes to marry Żaneta, a woman he met online, and [moves into her grandfather's run-down rural estate|trigger|making a new home]. Digging in the yard with a backhoe before the wedding, he [unearths a skeleton|images|corpses and body parts] and tells no one. Through the reception, with its vodka and loud music, a woman in a wedding dress draws ever closer, until Piotr has seizures and begins [speaking in her voice, in Yiddish|threat|being taken over], the voice of a Jewish girl who vanished before the war.
